title: Gathin23/cleanyourtv
why_read: A popular utility for debloating Android/Google TV devices, practically useful but technically modest in scope.
analysis: This project automates removing bloatware and customizing the home screen on Android and Google TV devices over Wi-Fi, likely using ADB commands under the hood. It solves a genuine consumer annoyance and has clearly resonated given its high star count, but the underlying technique (ADB scripting) is well understood and not novel. Useful as a tool, modest as an engineering story.
